g.text: Native OrthoHMM ablation: QfO development set
Initial HMM search on; P = 0, C = 0. Showing two cells; 2/7 fresh cells admitted.
D: thick = nominal 95% interval; thin = 42-endpoint adjusted interval. Retained draws reused only after exact family matches.
18 development-exposed SwissTrees families; conditional exchangeability and percentile-coverage limits. F1 adjusted interval includes zero.
No intervals for other QfO endpoints; unseeded FAS sample. Failed R-on inference timing excluded. Not a selected-default comparison.
